{{Quote|Master, Dooku can't actually believe this&mdash;this redroot-and-stick approach is going to work, can he? Not when he's got droid detachments occupying Lanos?''"<br />"''Not occupying. Liberating. From its crushing servitude to the corrupt and decayed Republic. Or haven't you been paying attention to the HoloNet?|Anakin Skywalker and Mace Windu|<ref name="Wild Space" />}}

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Wild Space Date" /> a '''battle''' took place in the [[Lanos system/Legends|Lanos system]] as part of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] fought between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Following the battle, Confederacy [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid forces]] occupied [[Lanos]] which some some on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] described as liberating Lanos from its crushing servitude to the corrupt Republic. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] briefly discussed the battle and resulting occupation of Lanos while they were reviewing the state of the war and planning how to handle an upcoming [[Conclave of Chanosant|recruitment event]] by the Confederacy.<ref name="Wild Space" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', a novel written by [[Karen Miller]] and published in [[2008]].<ref name="Wild Space" />
